svg.aria-label: The buyer’s history cabinet. Five drawers hold certificates #0 to #4, TES-INV-0000 to 0004, each riveted to the one before. A lender’s reader on a rail above the drawers moves from drawer to drawer: each drawer slides out, its certificate rises, the reader checks it against its entry on the public board at the back, which shows only N and a tag, and a 済 stamp lands on it; certificate #4, paid three days late, gets 遅. Whom each invoice was with is a blank blue bar. A plate at the back turns to the tally: on time, late, defaulted. Click it or press Enter to run it.
